title: NFT IP License Builder
tagline: NFT IP License Builder - DApp that helps adding IP licenses to any new NFT contracts
description:
On-chain smart contracts with dynamic IP license functionality. You may select exclusiveness, commercial or personal only usage and merchandise earnings limit per year.

Off-chain Web service facilitates code creation and checks text License. We have plans to extend functionality in the way that each NFT may have specific IP license.
how_its_made: It's deployed on Polygon testnet (Mumbain) using Remix. We checked other sponsors technologies but there was not any sense to increase a complexity. So, we stand with Visual Studio Code, Web3.JS and W3.CSS that was used on the Front-end side. Solidity smart contracts were built using Remix.
